metadata.title: MeBot verified showcase content pack
metadata.scope: Real opportunities, current Tanzanian technology/AI news and events, one telecom data snapshot, and one clearly labeled AI-authored evergreen reading prompt.
metadata.source_policy: All factual claims below are tied to the linked primary/organizer source. A missing source publication date is explicitly marked; the checked date is not presented as the publication date. Dates and open/closed status are checked as of 2026-10-28. Do not display expired calls as open.
metadata.known_exclusion: KijaniSpace Space-IoT call intentionally excluded because the page has conflicting deadline text (16 Nov 2026 in header vs 16 Oct 2026 in legacy footer). Verify with organizer before adding.
metadata.display_title_note: display_title_en/sw are concise MeBot UI headlines written/localized for display, not official publisher headlines or official source-title translations. Preserve source_title exactly for attribution and source details.

items.source_title: The Inclusive Finance for the Growth of Women and Youth MSMEs program
items.source_date_note: No publication date is shown on the live page; checked 2026-10-28.
items.status_as_of_2026_10_28: Cycle 2 is open; FSDT says applications close 5 November 2026. This is a near-term deadline.
items.summary_en: FSDT's EU-supported Impact Grant Fund offers eligible high-potential MSMEs non-repayable grants of up to TZS 30 million plus business-development support. The programme targets specified regions in Mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar, prioritises women- and youth-led firms, and lists women/youth ownership or leadership (ages 18–35) among its criteria. Priority sectors include climate-smart agriculture, clean energy, fisheries, circular economy and digital solutions.
items.summary_sw: FSDT inatoa ruzuku isiyohitaji kurejeshwa ya hadi shilingi milioni 30, pamoja na ushauri wa kukuza biashara. Ni kwa biashara ndogo na za kati zilizo katika maeneo maalumu Tanzania Bara na Zanzibar. Kipaumbele ni biashara zinazomilikiwa au kuendeshwa na wanawake au vijana wa miaka 18–35. Sekta za kipaumbele ni pamoja na kilimo kinachohimili mabadiliko ya tabianchi, nishati safi, uvuvi, uchumi mzunguko na suluhisho za kidijitali.
items.next_action_en: Check that the business operates in an eligible listed region and fits the full criteria, then review the application requirements and submit before 5 November.
items.next_action_sw: Hakikisha biashara yako iko kwenye eneo linalostahili na inakidhi vigezo vyote. Kisha pitia mahitaji ya maombi na utume kabla ya 5 Novemba.
items.display_note: Do not imply all Tanzanian regions or all MSMEs qualify. Link the current FSDT criteria and form.
items.display_title_en: FSDT grants for eligible small businesses
items.display_title_sw: Ruzuku ya FSDT kwa biashara zinazostahili

items.status_as_of_2026_10_28: Accepting solutions. Deadline is 6 November 2026 at 12:00 noon EST (20:00 EAT / Tanzania time).
items.summary_en: MIT Solve seeks technology-driven solutions that expand access to quality work, affordable housing and financial resilience. The challenge is global and accepts solutions across geography; its page says concept-only ideas are reviewed only under the Indigenous Communities Fellowship, so applicants should check the stage requirements.
items.summary_sw: MIT Solve inatafuta suluhisho za kiteknolojia zinazosaidia watu kupata ajira bora, makazi nafuu na usalama wa kifedha. Changamoto hii ni ya kimataifa. Wazo ambalo bado ni dhana pekee hupitiwa kwenye Indigenous Communities Fellowship tu, kwa hiyo kagua masharti ya hatua ya mradi kabla ya kutuma.
items.next_action_en: Check that the solution fits work, housing or financial resilience and meets the stage criteria; submit by 6 November, 20:00 Tanzania time.
items.next_action_sw: Kagua kama suluhisho lako linahusu ajira, makazi au ustawi wa kifedha, na kama limefikia hatua inayokubalika. Tuma kabla ya 6 Novemba saa mbili usiku kwa saa za Tanzania (20:00 EAT).
items.display_note: Deadline conversion uses EST (UTC−5) to Tanzania EAT (UTC+3). The challenge page says 12:00 noon EST. Do not present the US-based prize-specific awards as globally eligible unless their own terms allow it.
items.display_title_sw: Changamoto ya MIT Solve ya ustawi wa uchumi 2027

items.source_title: Tanzania Digital Health and Innovation Week 2026
items.publisher: Muhimbili University of Health and Allied Sciences (MUHAS) Digital Health and Innovation Alliance
items.source_date_note: No publication date is shown on the event page; checked 2026-10-28.
items.event_or_deadline_date: Programme listings include 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-13; flagship forum is 2026-11-12 to 2026-11-13.
items.status_as_of_2026_10_28: Upcoming. The official page lists a Register Now link and late-registration forum rates (TZS 50,000 for Tanzanian students; TZS 200,000 for Tanzanian non-students). Training fees and availability are separate; check the form.
items.summary_en: The programme lists an AI for Health Training and Buildathon (July–November), Health Data Analytics Training (2–6 November), a Girls and Women in HealthTech workshop (11 November), and the 6th Tanzania Digital Health and Innovation Forum (12–13 November) at UDSM New Library Conference Hall, Dar es Salaam.
items.summary_sw: Programu inajumuisha mafunzo ya vitendo na buildathon ya Akili Unde kwa Afya (Julai–Novemba), mafunzo ya uchanganuzi wa data za afya (2–6 Novemba), warsha ya tano kwa wasichana na wanawake katika teknolojia ya afya (11 Novemba), na Kongamano la 6 la Afya ya Kidijitali na Ubunifu Tanzania (12–13 Novemba) katika Ukumbi wa Mikutano wa Maktaba Mpya ya UDSM, Dar es Salaam.
items.next_action_en: Open the official registration page to confirm remaining seats and late rates; select the forum or training registration that matches your interest.
items.next_action_sw: Thibitisha nafasi zilizobaki na ada za sasa kwenye ukurasa rasmi. Chagua usajili wa kongamano au mafunzo yanayokufaa.
items.display_note: Forum event fees and training fees are different. Do not imply training enrolment remains open without checking the registration form.

items.summary_en: A Tanzania developer and technology event at Confucius UDSM, Dar es Salaam, bringing together developers, cybersecurity professionals, startups, AI companies and API providers. Listed topics include API security, DevSecOps, fintech APIs, AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
items.summary_sw: Mkutano wa APICon Tanzania utawakutanisha wasanidi programu, wataalamu wa usalama wa mtandao, startups, kampuni za AI na watoa API katika Confucius UDSM, Dar es Salaam. Mada ni pamoja na usalama wa API, DevSecOps, API za fintech, mawakala wa AI na Model Context Protocol (MCP).
items.next_action_en: Review the agenda and ticket options on the official event page; register if the topics fit your work or learning goals.
items.next_action_sw: Pitia ratiba na bei za tiketi kwenye ukurasa rasmi. Jisajili ikiwa mada zinaendana na kazi au malengo yako ya kujifunza.

items.summary_en: A three-day residential African AI gathering in Arusha for researchers, founders, engineers, policy thinkers and students. The organizer describes sessions on AI foundations and research, agents and edge deployment, and governance, policy and SDGs. Detailed session times and speakers are still to be published.
items.summary_sw: Mkutano wa siku tatu Arusha utawakutanisha watafiti, waanzilishi wa biashara, wahandisi, watunga sera na wanafunzi wanaofanya kazi na AI. Mada ni pamoja na misingi na utafiti wa AI, mawakala wa AI, kuendesha AI kwenye vifaa vilivyo karibu na mtumiaji (edge AI), pamoja na utawala, sera na Malengo ya Maendeleo Endelevu. Ratiba kamili itatangazwa baadaye.
items.next_action_en: Check the official registration tiers and the latest programme before booking a seat.
items.next_action_sw: Angalia aina za tiketi na ratiba ya karibuni kwenye ukurasa rasmi kabla ya kukata tiketi.

items.source_title: EAC Adopts AI Declaration Resolving to Establish Regional AI Fund and Prioritise AI Sovereignty
items.event_or_deadline_date: Declaration adopted at the 4th EAC Regional STI Conference, 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-01.
items.status_as_of_2026_10_28: Published policy news. EAC Partner States committed to establish a regional AI technologies fund and promote African AI sovereignty; this is a commitment, not confirmation that the fund is already operating.
items.summary_en: EAC Partner States committed to establish a Regional AI Technologies Fund and to support AI systems built on East African data, using regional infrastructure and local languages including Kiswahili, and governed by East Africans.
items.summary_sw: Nchi Wanachama wa EAC zimejizatiti kuanzisha Mfuko wa Kikanda wa Teknolojia za Akili Unde na kukuza mifumo ya AI inayotumia data za Afrika Mashariki, lugha zetu kama Kiswahili na miundombinu ya kikanda, chini ya usimamizi wa Waafrika Mashariki.
items.next_action_en: Read the declaration and consider what a Kiswahili-first, locally governed AI service could look like in Tanzania.
items.next_action_sw: Soma tamko hilo, kisha fikiria huduma ya AI inayoanza na Kiswahili na kutumia data za hapa inaweza kuwaje.
items.display_note: Use future/commitment language (plans to establish); do not say the regional fund is already disbursing grants.
items.display_title_en: EAC commits to a regional AI fund and digital sovereignty
items.display_title_sw: EAC yajizatiti kuanzisha mfuko wa AI wa kikanda

items.source_title: PDPC YASHIRIKI MKUTANO WA KIMATAIFA WA AKILI UNDE NA TEKNOLOJIA ZA KIDIJITALI
items.event_or_deadline_date: Global AI & Digital Summit took place 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-22 in Seoul; concluded by 2026-10-28.
items.status_as_of_2026_10_28: Recent news about a concluded summit, not an upcoming event or open call.
items.summary_en: Tanzania's Personal Data Protection Commission joined a government delegation at the Seoul summit, where ethical AI across agriculture, health, education, tourism and public services was discussed. The PDPC report says Tanzania also sought investment interest for the proposed Nala Techno Valley in Dodoma, including a planned AI data centre.
items.summary_sw: Tume ya Ulinzi wa Taarifa Binafsi (PDPC) ilijiunga na ujumbe wa Serikali ya Tanzania katika mkutano wa Seoul, uliojadili matumizi ya AI yenye maadili katika kilimo, afya, elimu, utalii na huduma za umma. Taarifa ya PDPC inasema ujumbe pia ulilenga kuvutia uwekezaji kwa mradi unaopangwa wa Nala Techno Valley, Dodoma, ukiwemo mpango wa kituo cha data cha AI.
items.next_action_en: Read the PDPC note for the data-protection angle and follow official updates on the proposed Nala Techno Valley.
items.next_action_sw: Soma taarifa ya PDPC kuhusu ulinzi wa taarifa binafsi, kisha fuatilia taarifa rasmi kuhusu mradi unaopendekezwa wa Nala Techno Valley.
items.display_note: Nala Techno Valley and its AI data centre are described as proposed/planned, not already built or funded.
items.display_title_en: PDPC joins Tanzania delegation at global AI summit
items.display_title_sw: PDPC yaungana na ujumbe wa Tanzania kwenye mkutano wa AI duniani

items.source_title: Communications Sector Performance Report — Quarter ending June 2026
items.event_or_deadline_date: Reporting period: quarter ending June 2026 (do not label as calendar Q4).
items.status_as_of_2026_10_28: Published on the TCRA site on 10 August 2026. The original report cover states quarter ending June 2026; use that period label and avoid an ambiguous generic Q4 label.
items.summary_en: For the quarter ending June 2026, TCRA reported 117.0 million mobile subscriptions and 62.79 million internet subscriptions. Internet subscriptions grew 6.48% from the previous quarter; data traffic rose 11.65% to 1,041 petabytes. Subscription counts are lines/accounts, not unique people.
items.summary_sw: Kwa robo iliyoishia Juni 2026, TCRA iliripoti usajili milioni 117 wa simu na milioni 62.79 wa intaneti. Usajili wa intaneti ulikua kwa asilimia 6.48 kutoka robo iliyotangulia, huku matumizi ya data yakiongezeka kwa asilimia 11.65 hadi petabaiti 1,041. Hizi ni idadi za usajili, si za watu wa kipekee.
items.next_action_en: Open the official report to compare mobile, internet, broadband and mobile-money trends; use the quarter-end date when quoting it.
items.next_action_sw: Fungua ripoti rasmi kulinganisha mwenendo wa simu, intaneti, broadband na mobile money. Unapotumia takwimu, taja kuwa ni za robo iliyoishia Juni 2026.
items.display_note: The TCRA catalogue page files this under Q4, but the original report title/cover says quarter ending June 2026. For display, use “quarter ending June 2026” only (not “calendar Q4”). Subscription counts are not unique users.

items.status_as_of_2026_10_28: Evergreen reading prompt grounded in a real UNESCO/Tanzania assessment. The prompt is AI-authored; it is not itself an official report, a news article or a UNESCO recommendation.
items.summary_en: AI-authored reading idea (not a reported story): use Tanzania's UNESCO AI-readiness assessment to reflect on five practical questions for a local AI product—language inclusion, data governance, digital infrastructure, institutional capacity and skills.
items.summary_sw: Wazo la kusoma lililoandaliwa na AI—si habari wala chapisho rasmi: tumia tathmini ya UNESCO kuhusu utayari wa AI Tanzania kutafakari mambo matano kwa bidhaa ya AI ya hapa: ujumuishaji wa lugha, usimamizi wa data, miundombinu ya kidijitali, uwezo wa taasisi na ujuzi.
items.next_action_en: Open the real assessment, then use the prompt as a short reflection—not as a substitute for the source report.
items.next_action_sw: Fungua tathmini halisi, kisha tumia wazo hili kama mwanzo wa tafakari—si badala ya kusoma ripoti yenyewe.
